BANGLADESH'S INTERIM government urged people Fridayto resist violence as soldiers and police fanned out across Dhaka and other cities following protests over the killing ofa popular youth leader, sparking fears of more unrest ahead of national elections in which he had been due to mn. Bangladesh is due to elect a new parliament in less than two months - a transition many hope will help the country recover from nearly twoyears of instability.
